security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes to menvcfg CSR changing the ADUE bit (bit 61) without executing a subsequent SFENCE.VMA with rs1=x0 and rs2=x0 to synchronize address-translation caches. This can occur during HSM suspend/resume CSR save-restore paths, cold boot initialization when configuring menvcfg before S-mode handoff, or any M-mode handler that modifies menvcfg.ADUE after translation has been enabled.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: csrw menvcfg, ... (ADUE bit toggled) not followed by SFENCE.VMA x0, x0 in the same execution window before any S-mode entry; grep for CSRW/CSRS/CSRC to menvcfg with ADUE mask 0x2000000000000000 missing subsequent sfence.vma
security_spec.summary: Missing SFENCE.VMA after menvcfg.ADUE change leaves stale A/D-bit interpretation cached in TLBs, risking lost or spurious hardware A/D updates on page table entries after OpenSBI writes menvcfg
